scenes.title: What did the data measure?
scenes.viewerPurpose: Show spending as a potentially misleading proxy for need; Name institutional history inside apparently neutral data
scenes.composition: Compare equal medical need with unequal recorded spending, keeping the two people equally visible. Show the hospital record forming from access, payment and what was measured.

scenes.title: The history inside a dataset
scenes.viewerPurpose: Compare whose experience becomes a record; Trace measurement differences into decisions
scenes.composition: Place medical, hiring and speech records beside gaps where experiences were never recorded. Follow one incomplete record into an assessment affecting a person.

scenes.title: Who disappears in the average?
scenes.viewerPurpose: Challenge the comfort of a strong average score; Explain why removing a label may preserve its proxies
scenes.composition: Keep a strong average score beside one visible failure that the average hides. Remove a sensitive field while related information remains visible in the record.
